description: Defines the TlsClientAuthenticationOptions class, which encapsulates TLS client authentication settings, wrapping around .NET's SslClientAuthenticationOptions, with properties for client certificates, protocols, revocation check mode, and target host, including a delegate for client certificate selection.

classes.name: TlsClientAuthenticationOptions
classes.description: Encapsulates TLS client authentication options, wrapping around SslClientAuthenticationOptions and providing properties to configure client certificates, protocols, revocation checks, and certificate selection.

methods.name: LocalCertificateSelectionCallback
methods.description: Property that gets or sets the callback used to select the local client certificate during TLS authentication.

methods.name: ClientCertificates
methods.description: Property to get or set the collection of client certificates used for authentication.

methods.name: EnabledSslProtocols
methods.description: Property to get or set the SSL/TLS protocols enabled for the connection.

methods.name: CertificateRevocationCheckMode
methods.description: Property to get or set the revocation checking mode for certificates.

methods.name: TargetHost
methods.description: Property to get or set the remote host name for the TLS connection.

methods.name: SslClientAuthenticationOptions
methods.description: Property exposing the underlying SslClientAuthenticationOptions instance.
